title: Build a Tiny Progressive Tutorial
description: A small generic course that demonstrates synchronized prose, actions, file snapshots, code changes, and validation hints.

lessons.title: Create Reader State
lessons.description: Inspect the starter files and make the first visible code change.

steps.title: Inspect the Starter
steps.prose: Start by reading the starter component. The course reader keeps this prose aligned with the file that matters at this point in the tutorial.

actions.description: Open src/App.vue and confirm the starter heading is present.

validation.description: Confirm the starter component contains a single heading.

steps.title: Personalize the Heading
steps.prose: Replace the placeholder heading with a clearer tutorial title. This step demonstrates an edit-file action and a code change with before and after states.

codeChanges.description: Update the visible heading for the tutorial.

lessons.title: Check the Work
lessons.description: Run a deterministic command and record the expected result.

steps.title: Run the Project
steps.prose: Use the normal package script to start the local project. The course records the command and the validation hint, but it does not call an AI service at runtime.

validation.description: The dev server should start without compile errors.
validation.expected: Nuxt starts and serves the component.

steps.title: Record a Manual Check
steps.prose: Open the rendered page and confirm that the visible heading matches the code state from the previous step.

actions.description: Verify the heading reads Progressive Tutorial.
